object.script:
function onTick() x = input.getNumber(1) y = input.getNumber(2)
target_x = input.getNumber(3) target_y = input.getNumber(4)
dx = target_x - x dy = target_y - y
distance = (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) ^ 0.5 azimuth = 90 - math.atan(dy / dx) * 180 / math.pi
if dx < 0 then azimuth = azimuth + 180 end
output.setNumber(1, azimuth) output.setNumber(2, distance / 1000) end

p = 0.02 standart_trim = -0.1
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target = input.getNumber(1) current = input.getNumber(2)
trim = standart_trim
if on then delta = target - current * 360 trim = -delta * p end
output.setNumber(1, trim) end

angle = 20
function onTick() extend = input.getBool(1)
position = 0
if extend then position = angle / 45 end
output.setNumber(1, position) end

p = 0.1 max_vertical_speed = 10
vertical_speed = 0
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target = input.getNumber(1) current = input.getNumber(2)
if on then vertical_speed = math.min(max_vertical_speed, math.max(-max_vertical_speed, (target - current) * p)) end
output.setNumber(1, vertical_speed) end

i = 0.04 max_pitch = 10
pitch = 0
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target = input.getNumber(1) current_speed = input.getNumber(2) current_pitch = input.getNumber(3)
if on then pitch = math.min(max_pitch, math.max(-max_pitch, pitch + (target - current_speed) * i)) else pitch = current_pitch * 360 end
output.setNumber(1, pitch) end

i = 0.0001 dead_zone = 0.01 min_throttle = 0.2
throttle = min_throttle
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1) target = input.getNumber(1) current_speed = input.getNumber(2) current_throttle = input.getNumber(3)
if on then throttle = math.max(min_throttle, math.min(1, throttle + (target - current_speed) * i)) else throttle = current_throttle end
up = false down = false
if current_throttle < throttle - dead_zone then up = true end
if current_throttle > throttle + dead_zone then down = true end
output.setBool(1, up) output.setBool(2, down) end

p = 0.02 standart_trim = 0
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target = input.getNumber(1) current = input.getNumber(2)
trim = standart_trim
if on then trim = (target - current * 360) * p end
output.setNumber(1, trim) end

p = 10 i = 0.01 max_roll = 60
integral = 0
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target = input.getNumber(1) current_speed = input.getNumber(2) current_roll = input.getNumber(3)
if on then integral = math.min(max_roll, math.max(-max_roll, integral + (target - current_speed * 360) * i)) roll = math.min(max_roll, math.max(-max_roll, target * p + integral)) else integral = 0 roll = current_roll * 360 end
output.setNumber(1, roll) end

p = 40 max_rotation_speed = 6
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
target_course = input.getNumber(1) current_course = input.getNumber(2) target_rotation_speed = input.getNumber(3)
rotation_speed = target_rotation_speed
if on then target_course = target_course / 360
if target_course < 0.5 then target_course = -target_course else target_course = 1 - target_course end
turn = current_course - target_course
if turn > 0.5 then turn = turn - 1 end
if turn < -0.5 then turn = 1 + turn end
rotation_speed = math.min(max_rotation_speed, math.max(-max_rotation_speed, turn * p)) end
output.setNumber(1, rotation_speed) end

x_land = 3570 y_land = -5650
run_course = 130 appr_proj = 20000 target_appr_dist = 30000 p = 2
course_rad = run_course * math.pi / 180
sin_course = math.sin(course_rad) cos_course = math.cos(course_rad)
target_x = x_land - sin_course * target_appr_dist target_y = y_land - cos_course * target_appr_dist
course = 0
function onTick() on = input.getBool(1)
x = input.getNumber(1) y = input.getNumber(2)
if on then dx = x - x_land dy = y - y_land
proj = -(sin_course * dx + cos_course * dy) shift = cos_course * dx - sin_course * dy
if proj > appr_proj then stat = "final" end
if stat == "appr" then course_guide = false gps_guide = true else course_guide = true gps_guide = false course = run_course - math.max(-90, math.min(90, math.atan(shift / proj) * 180 / math.pi * p)) end
else course_guide = false gps_guide = false stat = "appr" end
output.setNumber(1, target_x) output.setNumber(2, target_y) output.setNumber(3, course)
output.setBool(1, course_guide) output.setBool(2, gps_guide) end
